description: Ministry of Labour - Amended Order and Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Mr. H. S. R. Perera and National Housing Development Authority - Awards made to the Industrial Disputes between Mr. Aruna Priyanga Mudannayake and Sri Lanka Telecom PLC and between Mr. D. Samarasinghe and Sri Lanka Transport Board
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131). It involves legal procedures for settling an industrial dispute, references specific sections of the Act, and constitutes a formal legal notice published by the Commissioner of Labour. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and legal proceedings rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, or other specialized categories.
